body: JPMorgan Kinexys Moves Tokenized Collateral And Settlement Into Production Rails In 2026

sourceReview.reason: The 18 November OneBullEx story is a retrospective of previously announced Kinexys production capabilities, not a distinct new event. JPMorgan's own 12 August 2026 release already described live Tokenized Collateral Network capabilities and over $4 trillion cumulative transactions; its 19 October release documented JPM Coin on Ethereum. No new dated 18 November launch is substantiated.
